title: P2-15r index-status-workflow: Wire index_status and index_workflow as Runtime methods (or remove dead code)
description: Task P2-15r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-yrtka). Original bead asked to either wire or remove three dead-code APIs. Black-hat review round 1 confirmed the original framing is correct: the three APIs (index_status, index_workflow, pending_actions gate) are defined in the codebase but not wired into Runtime. Real source: crates/vb_runtime/src/ (Runtime struct has slots for index_status and index_workflow, but they are populated but not exposed). This bead's scope: (1) audit the three APIs and decide wire-vs-remove for each; (2) if wire, add them to Runtime::new_with_journal as initialization steps; (3) if remove, delete the dead code and the unit tests that reference them. The decision is binary: either all three are wired (preferred — they enable the status subcommand to query real state per master §44.15) or all three are removed (if they are unused). The black-hat recommended keeping P2-15 at P2 (not raising to P0) and accepting the dependency from P0-5b, because the pending_actions coordination in P0-5b requires the index_status machinery to be wired. Master §44.15 (operational affordances) implies these are needed; recommend: wire all three. Kani harness: prove index_status is consistent with the journal sequence. proptest: 100 random run states produce consistent index lookups.

THE SYSTEM SHALL either wire the pending_actions gate or remove the dead code; no half-state allowed

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return the actual run state from the index, not a hardcoded default

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT leave the three APIs in a half-state; they must be wired or removed
unwanted.because: Master §44.15 requires every API to be either live or absent; dead code is forbidden by the architecture contract

invariants: index_status is consistent with the journal sequence (master §44.15 invariant)
The three APIs are not in a half-state: either fully wired or fully removed
